summary.text: Sean M. Bennett is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 38, which covers Charleston and Dorchester Counties, serving since 2013.
He chairs the Senate Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bennett was born on May 13, 1968, in Charleston, and is a financial planner.
His official page lists a B.A. from the University of South Carolina in 1990.
He chaired the Greater Summerville/Dorchester County Chamber of Commerce from 2002 to 2010 and was president of the Rotary Club of Summerville in 2010.
He has served in the Senate since 2013, and his committees are Banking and Insurance, Corrections and Penology, Ethics (chairman), Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Transportation.
